title: The Resurrection and the Great Commission

questions.question: Toward the dawn of the first day of the week, who went to see the tomb of Jesus?
options: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
Peter and John
Salome and Joanna
Lazarus, Martha, and Mary
questions.correctAnswer: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:1 (ESV): "Now after the Sabbath, toward the dawn of the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb."

questions.question: There was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven. What did the angel do?
options: He came and rolled back the stone and sat on it
He shattered the stone into pieces
He spoke loudly from the sky so all Jerusalem heard
He opened the gates of the temple
questions.correctAnswer: He came and rolled back the stone and sat on it
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:2 (ESV): "And behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven and came and rolled back the stone and sat on it."

questions.question: What did the guards at the tomb do out of fear of the angel?
options: They trembled and became like dead men
They drew their swords and attacked the angel
They ran immediately to the chief priests
They fell down and began to pray
questions.correctAnswer: They trembled and became like dead men
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:4 (ESV): "And for fear of him the guards trembled and became like dead men."

questions.question: What message did the angel first give to the women at the tomb?
options: "Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, as he said."
"Weep for the Lord, for they have stolen him away."
"Return to Galilee and wait there for him to appear."
"Tell no one what you have seen here today."
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, as he said."
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:5-6 (ESV): "But the angel said to the women, 'Do not be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus who was crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, as he said...'"

questions.question: Where did the angel tell the women that Jesus was going before them, and where they would see Him?
options: Galilee
Jerusalem
Bethany
Nazareth
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:7 (ESV): "Then go quickly and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead, and behold, he is going before you to Galilee; there you will see him."

questions.question: How did the women depart from the tomb after the angel spoke to them?
options: With fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples
With trembling legs and confusion
In complete silence out of terror
Secretly, telling no one on the way
questions.correctAnswer: With fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:8 (ESV): "So they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples."

questions.question: While they were running to tell the disciples, Jesus met them and said "Greetings!" What did the women do next?
options: They came up and took hold of his feet and worshiped him
They fell backwards fearing a ghost
They wept and washed his hands
They stood still, unable to speak
questions.correctAnswer: They came up and took hold of his feet and worshiped him
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:9 (ESV): "And Jesus met them and said, 'Greetings!' And they came up and took hold of his feet and worshiped him."

questions.question: When the guards reported to the chief priests all that had happened, what solution did the priests and elders devise?
options: They gave a sufficient sum of money to the soldiers to say that "His disciples came by night and stole him away while we were asleep"
They ordered the soldiers killed for sleeping on duty
They told the soldiers to say an earthquake swallowed the body
They told the soldiers to flee from the governor to Syria
questions.correctAnswer: They gave a sufficient sum of money to the soldiers to say that "His disciples came by night and stole him away while we were asleep"
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:12-13 (ESV): "they gave a sufficient sum of money to the soldiers and said, 'Tell people, "His disciples came by night and stole him away while we were asleep."'"

questions.question: What did the priests promise the soldiers if the governor heard about them being "asleep"?
options: "We will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."
"We will hire lawyers from Rome for your defense."
"We will hide you in the temple until he forgets."
"We will claim you were guarding the inner treasury instead."
questions.correctAnswer: "We will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:14 (ESV): "And if this comes to the governor's ears, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble."

questions.question: Where do the eleven disciples go to meet Jesus in Galilee?
options: To the mountain to which Jesus had directed them
To the Sea of Galilee to fish
To the synagogue in Capernaum
To the house of Peter's mother-in-law
questions.correctAnswer: To the mountain to which Jesus had directed them
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:16 (ESV): "Now the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain to which Jesus had directed them."

questions.question: When the disciples saw Jesus on the mountain, they worshiped Him, but what did some do?
options: But some doubted
But some tried to touch his wounds
But some stayed behind the rocks out of fear
But some asked him if he would restore the kingdom to Israel
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:17 (ESV): "And when they saw him they worshiped him, but some doubted."

questions.question: Jesus came and spoke to them, establishing His authority before giving the Great Commission. What did He say?
options: "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me."
"I am the King of kings and Lord of lords."
"The Father has made me ruler over the nations."
"All powers of darkness have been vanquished."
questions.correctAnswer: "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me."
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:18 (ESV): "And Jesus came and said to them, 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.'"

questions.question: In the first part of the Great Commission, Jesus says: "Go therefore and..." do what?
options: make disciples of all nations
preach to the lost sheep of Israel
heal the sick and raise the dead
write down all that I have taught you
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:19 (ESV): "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations..."

questions.question: In whose name were the followers to baptize the disciples?
options: in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins
in the name of the Lord alone
in the name of the living God
questions.correctAnswer: in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:19 (ESV): "...baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: What is the final promise Jesus gives in the Gospel of Matthew?
options: "And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age."
"And I will send you another Helper who will be with you forever."
"And I will return quickly to judge the living and the dead."
"And your names are secured in the book of life in heaven."
questions.correctAnswer: "And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age."
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:20 (ESV): "teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age."

key_verse_text: "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you. And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age."
